english.meaning: to cook something in boiling water; to blanch or scald
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Wow, you guys are cooking? It definitely won’t taste good. You only know how to boil water.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嘩！你哋整嘢食啊？肯定唔好食喇。你哋淨係識攞水熠。
